start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-b.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=UTC && rm -f eval-b.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-b-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend only; npm start does not exist until E5-S1. Real setting names: DATABASE_PATH (SQLite file, shared by alembic via backend/alembic/env.py), PROVIDER_TIMEZONE, JWT_LIFETIME_MINUTES, BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS (.env.example), and JWT_SECRET (specs/design/deployment.md; not yet in .env.example, E1-S3 must add it per component-map; export it explicitly, min 32 bytes). DATABASE_PATH is relative to backend/ (cwd of the command), so sqlite3 inspection targets backend/eval-b.db. Server stdout/stderr is captured to eval-b-server.log. Live API checks need only /api/auth/*; no doctor/slot HTTP endpoints exist in group B (E2-S1 and E3-S1 are Service layer), so those are verified through pytest plus direct sqlite3 inspection.

content_rules: E1-S3 AC5: password hashing uses argon2; the password_hash is never returned in any response
E1-S3 AC2: the register request schema does not map a role field into the created user (role hard-coded PATIENT)
E2-S1: slot generator stores UTC-aware datetimes only and takes the clock from the injected Clock, not datetime.now() directly
E3-S1 AC3: stubs.py does not import or reference events_repo / appointment_events
E3-S1 AC1: api/deps.py binds a stub for each of Video, Payment, Prescription, Notification via overridable dependencies

review_notes: Lean mode: only checks mapped to E1-S3, E2-S1, E3-S1 acceptance criteria; generic lint/coverage/size gates omitted as in group A.
E2-S1 and E3-S1 are Service-layer stories with no HTTP endpoint in group B, so their checks are pytest commands (plus one sqlite3 duplicate check); no api-contracts endpoint covers them.
Live checks for E1-S3 correspond to API-03 and API-04 in specs/design/api-contracts.md; byte-identical 401 body and message 'Invalid email or password.' come from API-04 and the error table.
Test file names follow specs/design/component-map.md; if the generator needs different names it must update this contract first.

Removed B-API-20 (full-suite regression) and B-API-9 (PHI in logs) as neither traces to a group B acceptance criterion; removed alembic-hash and layering content rules for the same reason. Added B-API-2b, B-API-6c, B-API-17b and tightened B-API-3 and B-API-7b with sqlite3 assertions.
